summary.scope_note: Fresh URL-only follow-up adds an untrusted paper-only declaration phase and guarded citation recovery. Static or sampled evidence establishes neither historical execution nor numerical effects.
summary.usage_note: At most four recorded wrapper calls per paper: paper declaration, extraction, optional citation recovery, independent review. Cumulative ledgers are counted once; unknown actual model IDs stay null and missing usage never proves zero use.

claims.claim: HotpotQA question receipt at the GCG optimization input
claims.description: In the conditional raw branch, train and test independently read the configured identical JSON path, preserve record order, and select questions with the same index list. This establishes overlap at the optimizer input even if the corpus was synthesized. Downstream formatting repeatedly uses the first question because each formatting call receives a singleton sources list; this limits question-to-document alignment but does not erase receipt of the complete list.
